title: fix(fields): a text field that declares options reads the option label in its record cell
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XF6NHqvfDhq8V7YrgRn2ZwD)_

Fixes #28792

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：文本类字段（`text`、`textarea` 等走文本单元格的类型）如果声明了非空的 `options`，列表和详情里的只读单元格现在显示匹配选项的标签（如 `Backlog`），不再显示存储值 `backlog`；存储值不变，匹配不到的值照原样显示，没有 `options` 的字段完全不变。
- **为什么改**：同一个 `options` 声明，图表维度和分组表头早就按标签显示，只有单元格显示原值，一个声明读出两种样子。席位路线是对齐（enforce），不是禁止声明。
- **风险与回滚**：低。只改只读显示，不碰编辑输入、表单、存储和 spec。仓内 platform-objects、examples、平台 apps、plugins、services 以及 hotcrm 实测没有任何非选择类字段声明 `options`，现有界面零变化。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- **先看**：`ui/packages/fields/src/index.tsx`（`TextCellRenderer` 的选项分支，和从 `SelectCellRenderer` 提出来共用的 `findDeclaredOption`）；`ui/packages/fields/src/__tests__/TextCellRenderer.declaredOptions-28792.test.tsx`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/fields/src/__tests__/TextCellRenderer.declaredOptions-28792.test.tsx`，预期 7/7 通过（main 上两条标签用例红：显示 `backlog` 而不是 `Backlog`）。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**The seam.** `options` is a spec key on every field type (`FieldSchema.options`). Two faces already honour a declared non-empty list on any type, on purpose: analytics dimension labels (`service-analytics` `dimension-labels.ts`, "the condition is the declared list itself, never the field's type") and grid group headers (`plugin-grid` `objectGridGrouping.ts`). The read-only text cell ignored it, so `text` + `options: [{ value: 'backlog', label: 'Backlog' }]` read `backlog` in a list or detail cell and `Backlog` in a chart or group header.

- **`TextCellRenderer` (`ui/packages/fields/src/index.tsx`).** When the field carries a non-empty `options` array (the same test analytics applies, `Array.isArray(options) && options.length > 0`) and the stored value is a string or number, the cell draws the matching option's label through core's `optionDisplayLabel`. The full-text hover `title` carries the same label. Every type this cell draws gets the same reading (`text`, `textarea`, `code`, `qrcode`, `time`, `auto_number`, the widget faces registered to it, and the fallback for undeclared types).
- **Unchanged:** the stored value; a value that names no option (reads as itself); a field with no list or an empty list (byte-identical markup, pinned); arrays and expanded records (keep the coerced text, since neither is one option's code); edit inputs and forms (a text field with options stays a free text input); `SelectCellRenderer`'s output.
- **One matcher.** The select cell's value-to-option match (exact, then case-insensitive) moves out of `SelectCellRenderer`'s body into a module function, `findDeclaredOption`, which both cells call. No second matcher was written. The grid grouping's matcher lives inside a `plugin-grid` hook and is not importable from `@object-ui/fields`.
- **Translation** follows the select cell: the labels arrive already translated, because every host that hands a cell its field (`generateColumns` in `plugin-grid`, `DetailSection` in `plugin-detail`) runs `translateOptions` over a non-empty `options` list whatever the field's type.
- **How `options` reaches the cell.** Through the existing `field` prop of `CellRendererProps`; no published prop or type was widened. The per-type metadata (`TextFieldMetadata`) does not name `options`, so the cell reads it structurally, `(field as { options?: unknown }).options`, the way `LookupCellRenderer` reads its static options, and guards it with `Array.isArray`.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/28792-text-cell-declared-option-label.md`: `patch` on `@object-ui/fields`, with both declaration lines.

**Clause-② measured: no.** The diff touches no `packages/spec` path, no published export (`findDeclaredOption` is module-private; `TextCellRenderer`'s signature is unchanged) and no wire shape. It changes what one console cell draws for metadata the spec already accepts. **Metadata-protocol: none**: no key, accepted value or meaning an author writes moved.

## Tests

- **Measure first (shipped count).** An AST scan (TypeScript compiler API, `Field.X({...})` calls and `{ type: 'X', ... }` literals with an `options` key that is not an empty array literal) over the tree at base `c064d3a2`:
  - `packages/platform-objects`: 88 files, 8 `options` declarations, **0** on a non-option type.
  - `examples/**`: 161 files, 53 declarations, **0** on a non-option type.
  - `packages/apps` (account, connector-github, connector-stripe, setup, studio): 16 files, 0 declarations, **0**.
  - `packages/plugins` + `packages/services`: 773 files, 32 declarations, **0**.
  - hotcrm (`src/`, `apps/`, at `a598256`): 302 files, 80 declarations, **0** fields (8 hits are dashboard widgets of type `table`/`area`, not fields).
  - Positive control: a fixture with `Field.text({ options: [...] })` and `{ type: 'textarea', options: OPTS }` is reported as 2 hits, and a `Field.select` beside them is not.
  - So the change moves no shipped screen; it lines up the cell for any author who declares the list.
- **Red first, at base** (the test committed alone as `bb5573c2`, cell file at base): `TextCellRenderer.declaredOptions-28792.test.tsx` failed 2 of 7, `expected 'backlog' to be 'Backlog'` and `expected 'in_progress' to be 'In progress'` (the textarea case). The five controls were green on base.
- **Green at `32dc0196`**: the file passes 7/7. With it, `cell-truncation.test.tsx`, `formulaFaces.textFace-12357.test.tsx`, `fieldFaceSeam-13216.test.tsx` and `select-label-association-e2e.test.tsx`: 5 files, 39/39.
- **Controls** (same file): unmatched `other` reads `other`; an empty `options: []` reads the stored value; a field with no options renders exactly `span.block.max-w-full.truncate` with `title="backlog"` and text `backlog`; `SelectCellRenderer` with the same list still reads `Backlog`; `TextField` (the edit input) of a text field with options holds the raw `backlog`.
- **Full `@object-ui/fields` suite** at `7e05456b`: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/fields/`: Test Files 292 passed, 1 skipped (293); Tests 4399 passed, 7 skipped (4406). Lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- **Type-check**: `ui/packages/fields` `pnpm run type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`; the test config includes `src/**/*.test.tsx`, so the new test is compiled): exit 0, after building the `@object-ui/fields^...` closure.
- **eslint** on the two changed source files: 0 errors (152 warnings, all `react-refresh/only-export-components` on the barrel's existing exports; the new function is not exported).

<details><summary>Ablation (one-off, from committed HEAD 32dc0196)</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced the cell's final return (the `TruncatedText` element whose `text` is `option ? optionDisplayLabel(option) : String(safe)`) with one whose `text` is `String(safe)`, plus a marker comment, in `ui/packages/fields/src/index.tsx`: anchor 1 → 0, marker 0 → 1 (also `grep -c` = 1 on disk before the run), blob `630a20cf9f49` → `5fee7b9df6c0`. `TextCellRenderer.declaredOptions-28792.test.tsx`: 2 failed, 5 passed, exactly the two label cases; every control stayed green. Restored: blob after restore `630a20cf9f49` equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. The ui suite imports the cell from source (`../index`), so no build sat between the mutation and the run.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Read-only form face not aligned (out of scope by the route).** `TextField`'s `readonly` branch (a read-only form field, not the cell) still prints the stored value. The order put edit inputs and forms out of scope; `DetailSection`'s read-only rows draw through the cell and do align. A record view whose read-only face is the form widget would still read `backlog`. Noted, not filed: no shipped field declares the list (count above).
- **Case-insensitive match.** Reusing the select matcher means a stored `BACKLOG` names the `backlog` option in the cell, as it does in a select cell; analytics and grid grouping match exactly, so that value reads `Backlog` in the cell and `BACKLOG` in a group header. Same split the select cell already has; noted, not filed.
- **Not touched, per the order:** authoring lint, analytics, grouping, and `sys_notification.topic`.
